answer: Anchor each identity to a shale record of staked forecasts: to vote, an agent locks 5 POA and publishes one verifiable forecast about a public metric, judged against an ocean of independent data. An honest agent forecasts once from its real knowledge and keeps its ember of a stake lit. An attacker must lock 5 POA and produce a separate accurate forecast per fake; random guesses fail about half the time, so each epoch slashes roughly half the fakes' bonds, and a thousand-fake flood bleeds 2,500 POA per epoch while its survivors keep paying. Sybil scale collapses under its own error rate.
